takeaway: A pharyngeal pouch passes through Killian's dehiscence, between the thyropharyngeus and cricopharyngeus parts of the inferior constrictor.

lines.text: A 70-year-old woman has sudden bouts of severe coughing when she is asleep.
lines.say: A seventy-year-old woman has sudden bouts of severe coughing when she is asleep.

lines.text: Investigations show a pharyngeal pouch. But where exactly does it form?
lines.say: Investigations show a fa-RIN-jee-al pouch. But where exactly does it form?

lines.text: This muscle is thyropharyngeus, part of the inferior constrictor.
Below it lies cricopharyngeus, the other part of the same muscle.
Between these two parts is a gap called Killian's dehiscence.
A pharyngeal pouch pushes out through this gap.
So the pouch occurs between thyropharyngeus and cricopharyngeus.
